
## GeoNames gazetteer (accessed 2026-09-06)
Used by `scripts/04_geocode_nodes.py` to assign node coordinates.
Publisher: GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/)
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC-BY 4.0)
Coordinates taken from this source are POPULATED-PLACE CENTROIDS.
They are approximations of a town's location and are NOT pipeline
facility locations. Every node row records this in `coordinate_accuracy`.
